issue_context.title: use `advertise_IP:status_port` instead of `status_ip:status_port` when status_ip is not set
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Found from https://asktug.com/t/topic/62913 (Chinese version).
We should use `advertise_IP:status_port` instead of `status_ip:status_port` when status_ip is not set. Or `0.0.0.0:status_port` will be requested and the connection will be refused. 

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```
1. Keep the status_ip as default (0.0.0.0)
2. Query `show config`
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
All the configs can be fetched successfully.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
Warnings are returned. 
`Get http://0.0.0.0:20180/config: dial tcp 0.0.0.0:20180: connect: connection refused`

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
5db77b3068cfa5045f4d3187752d2d3798efcbdc at master
comments:
The `listen_port` section is designed to make it compatible for environment where IP address on server interface is not the same as what client actually used to connect it (when the server is behind a NAT device), a typical example is when in cloud platform where multiple VPC network is used.

In such an environment, the `host` address is an public IP address routeable on the Internet, but on the server, there is only a private IP of the VPC network available, when a process starts and try to bind to the public IP address, it will fail as the kernel does not know the address at all.

Besides, listening on `0.0.0.0` (and `::` for IPv6) should be the de facto behavior for network daemon programs as it's the most simple option for "when I start the process, I can access it from anywhere as long as the network is connected".
